decisions.reason: Having remained on the market after launch and drawing directly on the firm's core automation, formwork and control knowledge, the combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot is likely to be improved further rather than withdrawn.

The profile storage robot still fits the firm's established precast production-system capabilities and can be supported through its broad installed-base learning, although its more specialized use keeps withdrawal risk somewhat higher.

The automatic shuttering robot is closely aligned with the firm's long-standing machinery and system-integration expertise, so absorptive capacity and in-house R&D make continued refinement more probable than exit.

As a new 2024 product line with several models, this machine benefits from the firm's engineering and process know-how and offers scope for adaptation, but it still faces some early-market validation risk.

The production analysis software is close to the firm's established controls, service and consulting offer and supports its future-ready automation strategy, yet software monetization and customer adoption are somewhat less certain than for its core machinery.
